title: Align retrieval architecture responsibilities with explicit user directive
summary: DAG global orchestration; CAG cache; Agentic RAG single-agent autonomous retrieval; Multi-Agent RAG collaborative retrieval; GraphRAG,TAG,Memory,Multimodal specialized data paths; XRAG context compression. Existing permissions,evidence,resource,bounded execution and authority gates retained.
problem: C106 collapses specialized data paths and cache/context responsibilities
acceptance: no new authority, capability or scheduler created
existing canonical authority unchanged pending verified PostgreSQL retirement migration
